usage: agentware skill propose [-h] [--format {text,json}] --slug SLUG
                               --ref REF [--body BODY] [--run RUN]
                               [--worklog-line WORKLOG_LINE] [--to-shared]
                               [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --slug SLUG           stable lowercase kebab-case slug (the proposal id)
  --ref REF             the feature/run this proposal occurred in (uniqueness
                        key for proposal_count)
  --body BODY           proposal SKILL.md body ('-' reads stdin); first non-
                        empty line becomes the description
  --run RUN             optional run id recorded in the ledger event
  --worklog-line WORKLOG_LINE
                        optional worklog line reference for the ledger
  --to-shared           curator-only: propose into the shared/ root (CR-gated)
  --dry-run             report what this proposal WOULD record (new /
                        increment / near-duplicate refusal) without writing
                        the ledger or index
